name: nutrikit
description: Self-hostable nutrition API + SDK: food search, nutrient breakdowns, text/voice/photo meal logging, barcode and label scanning, meal plans. Built on open data (USDA FoodData Central, Open Food Facts).

scripts.build: npm run build -w web && npm run build -w server
scripts.test: docker compose up -d --wait postgres && npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:unit: npm test -w server && npm test -w web && npm test -w mcp
scripts.test:e2e: docker compose up -d --build --wait && npm test -w e2e
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web && npm run typecheck -w mcp && tsc -p e2e
